knowledge.name: Synthetic weekly campaign snapshot
knowledge.detail: Four fictional advertiser campaigns with planned and delivered reach, variance, sales lead, and status.

knowledge.name: Placement inventory records
knowledge.detail: Five fictional placements with extra reach this week and an available, sold-out, or pending status.

knowledge.name: Recommendation drafts
knowledge.detail: Four per-campaign drafts with approval status and any missing delivery data.

knowledge.name: Delivery rules and guardrails
knowledge.detail: Routing, evidence, and no-booking rules bundled as a synthetic knowledge file.

intelligence_processing.name: Delivery risk assessment
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares delivered reach with the weekly plan, explains the gap, and counts at-risk campaigns.

intelligence_processing.name: Extra reach matching
intelligence_processing.detail: Lists a campaign's placements with extra reach this week and their inventory status.

intelligence_processing.name: Make-good recommendation drafting
intelligence_processing.detail: Returns the drafted recommendation, its basis, approval status, and sales lead.

intelligence_processing.name: Missing delivery data detection
intelligence_processing.detail: Flags incomplete current-week delivery and blocks the recommendation instead of guessing.

intelligence_processing.name: Fail-closed campaign resolution
intelligence_processing.detail: Resolves a campaign by key, ID, or name, defaults to the demo campaign, and never substitutes one.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio ad sales experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the pilot with three skills and two synthetic knowledge files; the package stays Draft until review.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file CampaignDeliveryOptimizerAgent locally with deterministic campaign routing.

management_reporting.name: Weekly campaign risk view
management_reporting.detail: Planned reach, delivered reach, variance, delivery status, and the reason a campaign is at risk.

management_reporting.name: Available reach table
management_reporting.detail: Inventory ID, placement, extra reach this week, and inventory status for one campaign.

management_reporting.name: Recommendation for approval
management_reporting.detail: Draft recommendation, basis, approval status, and anything missing; nothing is shared.

management_reporting.name: Ad sales acceptance evidence
management_reporting.detail: Three locked ad operations, campaign manager, and sales lead cases, one per operation.

tools.name: Portable CampaignDeliveryOptimizerAgent
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with three deterministic read-only operations over synthetic delivery.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the three-skill package; publishing needs an authorized reviewer.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Sales
tools.detail: Cited read-only seam for campaigns and sales leads; no live connection in the package.

tools.name: Weekly delivery reports in Microsoft Excel
tools.detail: Cited read-only seam for delivered reach; synthetic records stand in.

tools.name: Inventory and placement records
tools.detail: Cited read-only seam for available placements; the agent never books or releases inventory.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic delivery evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Every campaign, reach figure, placement, and sales lead is invented; no browsing or live-system claims.

supporting_features.name: No booking or advertiser sharing
supporting_features.detail: Never books or releases inventory, changes a campaign or placement, or shares anything with an advertiser.

supporting_features.name: Sales lead approval gate
supporting_features.detail: Ad sales leads and ad operations managers approve every recommendation before any action.

supporting_features.name: Figures kept as returned
supporting_features.detail: Reach, variance, and extra reach are quoted exactly; answers never round or recompute them.

supporting_features.name: Controlled future writes
supporting_features.detail: Any later write needs authenticated tools, authorization checks, explicit human approval, and an audit log.
